paite: Sharon pak ka hi, phaizang lili pak.
Ling lak a lili pak bang in, huchibang in tanute lak ah ka it a-om hi.
heading: Pasal

paite: Gamlak singte lak a epul kung bang in, huchibang in tapate lak ah ka ngaihnou a-om hi. Nakpi a kipahna toh aliim nuai ah ka tu a, agah ka chep in akhum hi.
heading: Numei

paite: Ankuangluina inn ah ahon pi a, ka tung a kizak puanlap a-itna ahi.
Grep phoukeu in hon khou unla, epul thei in hon nem un; zawlngai in ka chi ana ngal a.
Akhut veilam ka lu nuai ah a-om a, akhut taklam in ahon kawi hi.
Zuktal leh gam a zukpite ka hon ngen hi, Aw Jerusalem tanute, ka it hihbuai kei unla, phawng kei un, alungkim matan.
Ka ngaihnou aw! Ngai un, ahong hi, tangte tung ah atawm a, mual tungte ah adiang hi.
heading: La Nihna / Numei

paite: Ka ngaihnou zaw zuktal hiam ahihkeileh sakhi tuailai bang ahi; Ngai in, ka kulhbaang nunglam uah adingh a, tohlette ah a-en a, anannate ah amah akimusak.
Ka ngaihnou in thu agen a, ka kiang ah, "Pasal thou in, ka it, ka kilawmnou, hong pai meng in," achi hi.
heading: Pasal

paite: Ngai in, phalbi lah abeita ngal a, vuah atheuta a, apaimangta hi;
Leitung ah pakte hong kilang a; vasate lasak hun ahong tung a, i gam uah vakhu aw akizata hi.
Theipi kung in gahhingte aminsak a, grep guite apaklun uhi, agimlimte uh asuaksak uhi. Thou ve, ka it, ka kilawmnou hong pai meng in.
Mun sang a suangpi heng a om, vakhu bang na hi, na mel hon musak inla, na aw hon zasak in, na aw akhum a, na mel ahoih hi.
Sehalte, grephuan hihsia, sehal neute hon matsak ve; ka grephuan uh apaklun ngal a.
Ka ngaihnou kei a ahi, kei amah a ka hi; lili pak lak ah aganta aching a,
heading: Numei

paite: Ni ahong nem a, limliapte aman matan, ka ngaihnou, kihei inla, Bether mual tung a zuktal hiam sakhi tuailai bang in om in.
